postings.title: Account Director
postings.description:
THE JOB / Account Director

We're seeking an experienced Account Director to lead key client relationships and project execution in our sports marketing and creative agency. This role involves strategic direction, best-in-class campaigns, and ensuring long-term client growth and satisfaction for global clients focused on key APAC regions.

The Account Director (AD) is a strategic leader responsible for developing, managing, and executing client accounts. They interact highly with clients, managing projects and actively pursuing new business development opportunities.

The ideal candidate excels in building positive relationships with clients, colleagues, and third parties. They possess expertise in project planning, events, activations, account, and process management. Experience working with complex organizations and sponsorship portfolios requiring consultative guidance in fast-paced scenarios is essential. 

THE WORK YOU’LL DO

The prime role of the AD will be to oversee sub-regions within APAC for a major global client, comprised of multiple markets, associated marketing lead, and overarching regional marketing lead. This global client is strategically critically to Octagon and has a vast global sponsorship portfolio as well as sophisticated business to utilizing those assets.

Client Leadership & Relationship Management

- Act as a key lead on day-to-day work across accounts.

- Build trusted, long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders

- Develop a deep understanding of local market teams’ needs & objectives

- Provide strategic counsel on sponsorship, brand positioning, and campaign effectiveness

- Lead regular client meetings, reporting, and performance reviews

Account and Program Leadership and Delivery: 

- Lead with a ‘can do’ attitude and proactive ownership of projects and process, upholding the highest quality standards, both in service, deliverables and global requirements of the client / brand

- Oversee the day-to-day operations of the account team which includes leading client status meetings, managing programming tracking documents, developing informative & thoughtful POVs, and crafting insightful wrap-up reports

- Manage multiple projects concurrently, with a proactive approach (events, activations, campaign support, new opportunity assessment etc)

- Conduct pre-planning, management, and implementation, including vendor vetting, contract review and negotiation, and event activation plans and supporting communication documents

New Business Development: 

- Actively identify, create and pursue new opportunities with the client

- Participate in new business development efforts to identify new clients to the agency

- Generate forward-thinking, creative ideas to improve sponsorship-led programs and develop differentiated use of existing partnerships

Financial Acumen: 

- Oversee and drive financial health of accounts remaining financially aware and helping ensure that the company’s financial targets are achieved.

- Review of actual v SOW fees and timesheet tracking on a continual basis ensuring the agency’s fees/time billed is on track

Team Management: 

- Lead and manage a team of reports who will support you on the account, inspiring loyalty, and commitment providing relevant level of support while instilling confidence, motivation and empowerment

- Provide feedback on a regular basis and ensuring career progression is supported, allowing team members to become effective, independent and increasingly capable of working well with less supervision

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Knowledge and Experience:

- 6 - 8+ years’ experience working in account management, project management or client service with a brand, agency and/or team or sports or entertainment property

- Extensive experiential, sponsorship activation, event, experience is a desirable

- Extensive experience of owning and growing positive and effective relationships with senior client stakeholders, resulting in account growth and evolution; ability to cultivate strong relationships with staff, other internal stakeholders, vendors and partners

- Exceptional attention to detail, alongside organizational, time and project management skills

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Software (specifically PowerPoint, Excel and Word)

- Strong Chinese language ability

Others:

- You have a passion and/or interest in the power of sports and/or entertainment, gaming, music and/or celebrity & lifestyle culture

- Willingness and flexibility to travel and work weekend/holidays as needed

We make our careers website accessible to any and all users. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at JobAppAccommodation@ipgdxtra.com. This email address is not for general employment inquiries or vendors; rather it is strictly for applicants who require special assistance accessing our employment website. Due to volume, messages sent to this email address that are not related to an accommodation cannot be answered.

postings.title: Account Executive (Fixed Term Contract)
postings.description:
THE JOB / Role Title

The Account Executive (AE) role is a fixed term contract position from October to April 2027.

The AE is role is pivotal within both their account team and the broader client services department, where they'll oversee the administrative and operational aspects of accounts. Building enduring relationships with clients, suppliers, and agency partners and consistently delivering excellence are key responsibilities. Close collaboration with Account Managers and Account Directors ensures the successful delivery of all project work.

The ideal candidate for the AE position is dynamic, deeply invested in culture, and adept at multitasking across multiple projects. They are encouraged to bring their unique skills to the role, demonstrate a passion for learning, and display a strong commitment to completing tasks effectively. The AE's approach to client service is characterised by its energy and willingness to question established norms in pursuit of improved solutions. While professional client communication is a must, AEs are not expected to "manage" or “own” client relationships. Overall, the ideal candidate thrives in a team-oriented environment, embraces learning, enjoys the sports and entertainment industry, excels in a dynamic setting, pays meticulous attention to details, and takes immense pride in their work.

THE WORK YOU’LL DO

Client Relationship Development:

- Become a trusted resource for clients, effectively facilitating communication between all internal and external partners

- Develop a knowledge and understanding of the client’s portfolio and business initiatives

Account and Program Leadership and Delivery: 

- Provide project management support coordinating team & client diaries, WIP meetings, contact reports, timelines to ensure delivery

- Assist with event planning, guest communication, ticket management, compliance systems, onsite activation, and post-event wrap-up for various programs

- Support account teams in the delivery of attention-grabbing campaigns / activations / events

- Assist with the management of all assets that are used to fulfill a wide range of client business objectives and manage program expenses and internal admin & finance processes

- Co-coordinate projects with outside vendors & suppliers and internal resources, such as merchandise, digital and creative

- Help with the management of the online system used to upload assets, track, manage and fulfill orders or ticketing requests at events

- Participate in brainstorming sessions and regular status meetings by creating agendas, updating WIP reports, participating in the discussion and providing recap summaries

- Prepare necessary documents including guidelines, sell in presentations, presentation & pre-event materials, post-project recaps, competitor & market reports, research reports, event guides, workplans, asset trackers, itineraries, agendas, meeting notes, calendars, SOPs, etc.

- Ability to work on ground at event & activations when scheduled (please note this could be weekends, day / evenings)

Growing Agency Expertise: 

- Engage in inter-agency activities, ensuring the role of culture is championed

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Knowledge and Experience:

- 0-2 years of relevant experience in agency/client service, event marketing, and/or sports marketing, and a passion for working with sports & entertainment properties, leagues, teams, gaming, music and/or celebrity & lifestyle culture. Proven track record or study in marketing or advertising will be highly valued. But we’re keen on diversity of experience, so happy to consider non-marketing backgrounds.

- At a minimum an understanding and passion for creativity and ideas which earn attention is a must!

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Publisher)

Skills:

- Excellent organisational skills, acute attention to detail, and ability to manage tasks simultaneously and multitask shifting priorities

- Exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, and have the ability to communicate with clients independently

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organise, and analyse significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy

- You demonstrate persistence to make sure the client’s questions and reports are delivered in a timely and thorough manner

Ability:

- A positive attitude and “no job is too small” approach, with the initiative to go above and beyond. You are a go-getter, you demonstrate initiative, accept new challenges and seeks out opportunity to help others

- Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment and to thrive under pressure, with exceptional problem-solving skills-offering creative solutions

- You are curious, coachable and have a desire to learn in a fast-paced work environment. You have a passion and interest in the power of sports and/or entertainment.

Others:

- You have a passion and/or interest in the power of sports and/or entertainment, gaming, music and/or celebrity & lifestyle culture

- Willingness and flexibility to travel and work weekend/holidays as needed to support on-site client activities and events

postings.title: Creative Intern
postings.description:
WHO WE ARE

Octagon is a creative agency specialising in sports, entertainment, and culture. We believe in powerful partnerships and generous ideas to earn the attention of fans. We work with brands to create big ideas and shared stories that fans love and want to play with. Why? Because today we believe you need to earn attention not buy it.

THE JOB / LEFT FIELD (Creative Internship) 

LEFT FIELD

Our 3-month internship program for lovers of lateral play

An internship for the out-of-the-box thinkers and of-the-wall thinkers. For the fiery upstarts and the young at heart. For those keen to learn. To push. To play.

To smash boundaries out of the way.

Now recruiting for our next Season. 

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for interns across both Art and Copy with an aim of elevating diversity in the ad world and helping the next generation of creative talent get their foot in the door.

Regardless of backgrounds, we’re interested in getting to know you if you’re:

- Curious with an interest in growing your creative capabilities

- Detail-oriented with a positive, can-do attitude

- A confident communicator in English

THE WORK YOU’LL DO

- Hunt down the latest trends and tap on the pulse of culture 🤠

- Actively participate in brainstorming sessions to generate left field creative ideas 💡

- Design 👀 visuals and / or write killer copy

- Work closely with Strategy, Account, and Production Teams to bring to life projects from conceptualization 📝 to launch 🚀

NEXT STEPS

Send in your application via the link. If you’re shortlisted, our team will be reaching out with a brief for you to respond.

postings.title: Sports Consultancy and Data Analyst Intern (Futures Sport & Entertainment)
postings.description:
Futures Sport and Entertainment

With offices in Sydney, London and New York we provide strategic consultancy services based on market leading analytics, to service premier sport’s governing bodies, leagues, teams and broadcasters across the globe. Internationally, our clients include the NFL, NBA, NHL, Manchester United, Adidas, PlayStation and the UFC whilst domestically we work alongside Tennis Australia, and Supercars to name a few.

An opportunity exists to join our team as part of a course-credit internship requirement, that will provide you with hands-on experience and a true taste for the sports industry and our business in consultancy, research and insights.

Working in either a single block or on a regular part-time basis you’ll be partnered with a Graduate Analyst or Analyst for the duration of your internship, briefly shadowing their experience while also getting an immediate opportunity to immerse yourself in the collection, review and analysis of real-life data. From the get-go interns are given the opportunity to understand how to interpret data and form insights that will inform commercial and business strategy that shapes the Australian sports landscape.

Specifically, the internship will see you undertake:

- Use of internal apps and software to collect and store data required by analysts

- Collection and cleaning of sports match data to explain trends in audiences and brand exposure patterns, boosting your Excel skills

- Analysis and insights to help understand patterns in camerawork and drivers of brand exposure during sports broadcasts, putting your creative thinking to the test, through watching sport!

- Analysis and summary of trends in Futures sports fan surveys

- Other administration tasks requiring strong attention to detail

Desired skills:

- Have an interest in sport and the business of sport and entertainment

- Be a driven and diligent self-starter

- Have meticulous attention to detail

- Have high academic grades

- Ideally have experience with Excel

Eligibility For Internships

Before you apply, please ensure you meet the below requirements:

- You are currently enrolled in an Australian tertiary course that requires you to undertake an internship/placement (arranged by the educational institution or the students’ own initiative) in line with the requirements of your course

- It can be a component of the course as a whole, or of an individual subject or module. Please provide your course and subject details along with the number of internship hours required to be completed as part of your coursework

Please note: Our internship places are non-paid positions and must be undertaken as a requirement of an education or training course, in line with the Fair Work Act 2009.
